high_level_description: The image shows the exterior of a Standard Chartered bank branch. The most prominent feature is the large, three-dimensional sign that reads "Standard Chartered" in bold, white letters against a beige stone background. To the left of the text, there is a logo consisting of a blue and green abstract design, which is part of the bank's branding. Below the main sign, there is additional text in white that reads: "Standard Chartered weighs breaking up corporate, investment bank." This suggests that the bank is considering restructuring its corporate and investment banking divisions.
